u0: At the start, no matching key has been located, the locked target door is still closed, and the mission ball has not been picked up. The agent must find the matching key, open the locked target door with it, and then pick up the ball; if the key is found, opening that door and eventually picking up the ball become mandatory. Picking up the ball before the door has been opened would fail the task.
u1: The agent has picked up the mission ball while the locked target door was not open, so the required order of opening the door before the pickup was broken. This is an irreversible failure: the mandatory door-before-ball requirement, and any key-to-door obligation triggered by having found the key, can no longer be satisfied. Successful completion is no longer possible.
u2: This stage records that the locked target door has been opened at least once while the matching key has never been located, and the ball has not yet been picked up. That combination should not occur in normal play, since the locked door can only be opened after the key is found and carried. If it were encountered, the remaining objective would be to pick up the mission ball; locating the key first would still leave the door-opening condition already met and the pickup outstanding.
u3: The mission ball has been picked up, so the task is complete and the episode ends successfully. The locked target door had been opened before the pickup, and any earlier discovery of the matching key is followed by the required door opening and eventual pickup. No further action is required.
u4: The matching key has been located, but the locked target door is still closed and the ball has not been picked up. The agent must obtain or use that key to open the door and then pick up the mission ball; the key discovery also commits the agent to opening the door and eventually completing the pickup. Picking up the ball now, before the door is open, would fail the task.
u5: The matching key has been located and the locked target door has been opened, but the mission ball has not yet been picked up. The remaining objective is to enter the target room if needed, drop the key to free a hand if still carrying it, and pick up the ball; if the door has closed before the agent gets through, it must be reopened. Picking up the ball completes the task.
